Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting separate billing of tenants for water and wastewater services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to separate billing of tenants for water andwastewater services; and adding a new section to chapter 59.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 59.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A landlord shall not bill a tenant separately for water orwastewater services, or engage or authorize a third party billing agentto bill a tenant separately for water or wastewater services, unlessthe water or wastewater service is measured by an individual meter forthat tenant's dwelling unit. If a dwelling unit does not have anindividual meter for measuring the water and wastewater usage in thedwelling unit, the landlord must include the charge for water andwastewater services for the dwelling unit as part of the rent due underthe rental agreement for that dwelling unit.
